name: Sri Lankan Beetroot Curry
steps: Peel beetroot and dice it into even 1.5 cm cubes so it cooks uniformly. Thinly slice onion and keep the curry leaves ready; beetroot may stain work surfaces.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pan over medium heat. Add mustard and fenugreek seeds, then curry leaves and cinnamon; stir for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in garlic and turmeric for 1 minute, then add diced beetroot and salt and toss until each piece is coated.
Pour in 150 ml water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in coconut milk and cook gently for another 8 minutes until the beetroot is tender and the sauce is vivid pink; avoid a fierce boil.
Stir in vinegar, simmer for 1 minute and taste. Remove the cinnamon stick and serve with rice while the beetroot pieces still hold their shape.
tips: The vinegar balances beetroot's sweetness and brightens its colour. Add coconut milk after the beetroot has partly softened, then keep the heat gentle.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
